description: On the tabletop in front of you is a light-colored rectangular base piece with holes and several small parts, including two black wheels and small pegs. The left hand steadies the base while the right hand picks up a black wheel, rotates and aligns it with a peg/axle area, then both hands come together to press and secure the wheel; the right hand then places the assembled piece down and the left hand adjusts it so the base sits flat with a wheel on each end before both hands release.
